references.text: The high priests' order to report on Jesus' whereabouts is here extended to include Lazarus, whom they also plan to kill because he is a living witness to Jesus' power.
The order to seize Jesus (πιάσωσιν αὐτόν) in 11:57 is fulfilled here, as a crowd of chief priests and Pharisees comes to arrest him.
A parallel account where the chief priests and elders gather to find a way to take Jesus captive, leading them to give instructions to keep watch on him.
Mark recounts how the chief priests and scribes are looking for a way to take Jesus captive, a theme that is central in John 11:57.
